item.title: Version 0.1.0
item.description:
FinderGit 0.1.0 — first public release

  • Git-aware file browser with sortable columns
  • Status badges per repository: clean / dirty / unpushed
  • Inline diff viewer for modified files
  • Stage / unstage / commit / push / pull / fetch from the UI
  • Native Markdown preview via Quick Look (Space)
  • Auto-updates via Sparkle
